name: teamsherrard-realtor
description: Team Sherrard's plug-and-play AI systems for real estate agents.

plugins.name: realtor-ai-brain
plugins.description: PLUGIN 1 — install first. The Realtor AI Brain: one shared brain (the agent's identity + memory) that powers every other system. Run 'Set up my Brain' once, and every tool already knows the agent. Plus a system-wide Capture layer: talk on the go and your ideas, wins, vendors, and market notes file themselves into the Brain.

plugins.name: realtor-ai-admin
plugins.description: PLUGIN 2 — the AI Admin (The Agent Leverage OS). 17 skills that run the back office: scheduling, inbox triage and sweep, a 7am briefing, client memory, meeting prep, end-of-day wrap, and on-the-go Dispatch (talk while driving — it logs, reminds, and drafts). Plus Match-Back (name a listing, it finds the buyers already in your notes), Chase (who owes me, with ready nudges), filing, vendor dispatch, showing-feedback chasing, and the Friday scorecard. Requires Plugin 1 (the Brain).

plugins.name: realtor-youtube-system
plugins.description: PLUGIN 3 — the YouTube System. Starts with a complete YouTube Game Plan built on Mike Sherrard's frameworks: channel audit, 3 high-intent pillars, ~50 exact titles, goal-math, a 90-day plan. Then the channel page paste-by-paste, ideation, research, SEO, scripting in the agent's own voice, lead magnets, repurposing, a monthly deep dive on live data (channel, competitors, gaps, next 30 days), coaching, and a comment engine — all on a live Notion dashboard. Requires Plugin 1 (the Brain).

plugins.name: realtor-shortform-system
plugins.description: PLUGIN 4 — the Short-Form System. A routine-based OS: daily green-screen reactions, talking-head value, and carousels, each optimized for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. The agent thinks in formats; Claude keeps the funnel balanced, schedules through their own Metricool / GoHighLevel / Buffer, and reads live performance — a monthly deep dive plus quick reads, with reel watch-time and skip-rate no scheduler exposes. Text only. Requires Plugin 1 (the Brain).

plugins.name: realtor-lead-capture
plugins.description: PLUGIN 5 — the Lead Capture System. The first lead magnet is locked as the relocation guide (the highest-intent search traffic in every market), built from a 5-question intake pre-filled from the Brain; more guides unlock from campaign two. Then the opt-in funnel that gives it away. Plus the local-presence layer: the full Google Business Profile kit and platform-sized bios for every network, each carrying one entity line so AI search can find them. Requires Plugin 1 (the Brain).

plugins.name: realtor-ai-editor
plugins.description: PLUGIN 6 — the AI Editor. The agent talks in plain English; Claude directs Descript (their own account) to do the real editing — long-form and short-form in one tool — while they watch it happen live. Claude adds the multi-source B-roll Descript can't source itself (their own footage, listing photos, free stock), and a navigator turns vague requests into one clear plan. Requires Plugin 1 (the Brain) plus a Descript connection.

plugins.name: realtor-listing-launch
plugins.description: PLUGIN 7 — the Listing Launch System. One input — the address, or one sentence on the go — and every listing becomes a content and lead-gen event across eleven stages: WIN IT, LIST IT, LAUNCH IT, FILM IT, TOUR IT, CLIP IT, SHOW IT, SERVE IT, REVIVE IT, SELL IT, CLOSE IT. Plus brochures, postcards, outreach, a Notion pipeline board, one-command scheduling, a morning watch, and analytics from the agent's own closed listings. Requires Plugin 1 (the Brain).

plugins.name: realtor-market-system
plugins.description: PLUGIN 8 — the Monthly Market System. It schedules itself, times itself to when the agent's real estate board actually publishes, then every month pulls the fresh local numbers and builds the whole package: the presentation they screen-record, the PDF report, three shorts, the Instagram infographic and carousel, and the newsletter. It even grades last month's on-camera prediction. Between runs it's a market advisor in chat. Requires Plugin 1 (the Brain).

plugins.name: cohort-claude-support
plugins.description: PLUGIN 9 — Cohort Claude Support. The calm support desk inside Cowork: say "help" and it answers any Claude question, diagnoses breakage with real checks, teaches in plain English, audits setup and resumes at the first missing step, tracks the cohort week, and escalates with a complete pre-built ticket. Knows all 9 plugins and routes every fix to the skill that owns it; never touches the member's data. Works best with Plugin 1 (the Brain).

plugins.name: realtor-riverside-editor
plugins.description: PLUGIN 10 — the AI Editing Studio (Riverside engine). A full-time video editor inside the agent's Claude: 28 skills across DIRECT, CUT, POLISH, REPURPOSE, and SHIP, plus a plain-English navigator that resumes any stopped edit and three full recipes (long-form, reel, listing). Claude edits in the agent's own Riverside account with verifiable operations — no per-edit AI credits, every change proven by a revision diff. Requires Plugin 1 (the Brain) and a Riverside Grow plan.
